title: Sowing in the Famine Not Lack
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he tackles the age-old question of giving during tough times, sharing a powerful message of faith and obedience that will challenge you to see your circumstances differently. In this sermon, Pastor Chris reminds us that God's economy is not based on our circumstances, but on His promise to provide for His children. Listen to learn how to break free from the cycle of lack and trust God to make a way, even when it seems impossible.
